title: 2024 Topps Update Series Stars of MLB Insert Shota Imanaga #SMLB-81 Chicago Cubs
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2024 Topps Update Series Stars of MLB Insert Trading Card featuring Shota Imanaga, player for the Chicago Cubs in Major League Baseball. The card is made of high-quality card stock material and has a standard size. It is an original, licensed reprint with the card number SMLB-81. 

The card is a great addition for collectors, especially those who are fans of the Chicago Cubs or baseball in general. It features Imanaga as a rookie, making it a must-have for fans of the sport. The card is manufactured by Topps and is part of the 2024 Topps Update Series set. It is a single trading card and is categorized under Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop and Sports Trading Cards.
